source: Zhang et al. (2024): a JWST MIRI LRS phase curve of 12.7 hours with two eclipses (GO 2508). Eclipse depth 79 +/- 4 ppm, white light, 5 to 12 um (abstract and the table of white-light phase-curve parameters, F_p,day/F_*); the range is its one-sigma interval. Radius ratio 0.01364 +/- 0.00023 (table of white-light phase-curve parameters, R_p/R_s), fitted with the depth. The paper finds the day side fully consistent with a zero-albedo planet with no heat recirculation: a dark, hot, airless sub-Earth. https://arxiv.org/abs/2401.01400
